high_level_description: Wordless editorial gouache illustration of one frozen decision moment: a sandboxed creature inserts a single shaped request capsule into a central inspection hatch, while the node custodian alone controls the closed gate and protected vault; no duplicate objects, text, arrows, panels, charts, or diagram graphics.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A tall pale-cream room split vertically by one solid coral security wall from ceiling to floor, creating a cobalt-floored sandbox side on the left and a mustard-floored trusted side on the right. One inspection hatch is built into the wall at chest height. Cool-neutral daylight and broad empty space keep the boundary dominant. No readable text, letters, numbers, arrows, labels, signs, interface panels, charts, maps, diagram boxes, cables, secondary machines, decorative props, or repeated capsules appear anywhere.

elements.desc: The primary background element, a single black-steel inspection hatch embedded through the coral wall, with two closed shutters and a transparent central chamber containing the only request capsule. The capsule has a precise three-lobed brass profile fitting the chamber gauge exactly; one large coral lever exists only on the trusted right side.

Transparent sandbox enclosure with its featured friendly cobalt paper creature inside, treated as one unified display case on the left. The creature has cream hands, coral ears, an attentive expression, and a seated pose facing the hatch; its empty right hand remains beside the narrow submission port after placing the capsule inside.

Node custodian standing entirely on the trusted right side, medium-brown skin, short gray curls, cobalt shirt, cream overalls, coral shoes, calm serious expression, and gaze fixed on the capsule inside the chamber. Her left hand rests on the hatch lever while her right hand holds the uniquely shaped local authorization key.

Protected local vault positioned behind the custodian on the trusted side, built from thick cobalt steel with a closed coral door, one brass keyway, and three sealed cream containers visible through reinforced glass. The vault has no opening, handle, pipe, cable, or reachable surface facing the sandbox side.
